heading: Tonight
text: Any rain showers tapering off, and skies clearing. Lows in the 30s to near 40. Northwest wind near 10 mph, diminishing to calm overnight.

heading: Saturday
text: Sunny and seasonably cool. Highs in the 50s north, in the 60s south. Light and variable wind.

heading: Saturday Night
text: Mostly clear late, then clouds increasing south to north after midnight. Lows in the 30s to near 40, dipping to the 20s in the cold spots. Light and variable wind.
